It blends product design, brand storytelling and enterprise experience to deliver both creative distinction and measurable business impact.

Demographica is a leading South African B2B specialist agency known for data-driven marketing and long-term client partnerships. The agency has repeatedly been recognized at the B2B Marketing Awards and ranks among Africa’s top B2B firms. Demographica is admired for its analytical approach and for building marketing programs with measurable commercial returns.

An agency purpose-built to help companies succeed in today’s dynamic B2B environment, Dentsu B2B builds relationships with the people that matter by creating compelling, meaningful experiences at the moments that matter the most.

The firm helps clients in tech and professional services break out of conventional tactics via ABM, deal-based marketing (DBM) and creative communications that shift the dial. Its annual B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report, in partnership with LinkedIn, underscores its data-driven insight. The firm has been ranked #1 in the UK & Ireland for B2B agency performance. Founded in 1952 and still family-owned, Edelman leverages its global network and strategic depth to deliver trusted brand-to-business campaigns.

Its dedicated B2B team delivers integrated programs combining thought leadership, digital content, media relations and advertising, such as a program for Swisslog that drove 76% more leads and 162% more downloads.

It has been recognized for its integrated delivery model, B-Corp certification and Best Places to Work awards in the B2B sector.

The highly awarded agency successfully turned challenges into opportunity for clients including Airbus and 3M.

Since its founding in 2001, it has helped major clients such as Telstra, REA Group, Nestlé and Korn Ferry deliver strategic ABM, demand-gen and full-funnel brand-to-demand campaigns. Known for its thought-leadership – including the annual APAC B2B Buyer Journey report – the agency is celebrated for combining bold creative with measurable commercial outcomes.

Over 100 awards and a B-Corp certification underscore its commitment to quality and impact.

They focus on ABM, demand generation, lead generation, sales enablement, websites and content strategy, helping clients in technology, SaaS, IoT and industrial sectors drive measurable revenue impact. The agency is HubSpot Diamond Certified, Google Partner and known for helping clients increase search ranking, MQLs and SQLs in complex B2B environments.

Just Global is a global B2B marketing agency helping enterprise brands scale via a unified brand-to-revenue model. It fuses data, AI, insights and human creativity to deliver full-funnel, connected experiences for clients like OpenText, Databricks and Zoho. A recipient of the Global B2B Agency of the Year award, its integrated teams across the US, EMEA and APAC drive growth in complex international markets.

Havas Business is the specialist B2B division of Havas Media Group, built to bring ‘media to the boardroom’ for enterprise brands. The unit offers strategy consulting, holistic activation and measurement across full-funnel B2B campaigns, working with clients such as 3M, JDE Professional and Maersk and winning major effectiveness awards.

Lesniak Swann is a UK-based B2B marketing agency specializing in technically complex industries such as construction, industrial manufacturing and telecoms. With major clients including Michelin, Cat dealer Finning UK & Ireland, Polypipe Building Services and Reynaers Aluminium, the agency combines deep sector insight with bold creative ideas. Its work has earned multiple industry awards, including PR Agency of the Year at the Construction Marketing Awards and nominations across the CIPR and The Drum B2B awards. Founded in 2002, Lesniak Swann brings strategic thinking and measurable results to niche B2B markets.

LogicLogicMagic is a boutique London-based B2B technology marketing agency. It positions itself at the intersection of creative ingenuity and strategic logic, helping tech brands like Okta, Lenovo, Epson, SAP and SEMrush with brand, demand generation and sales enablement campaigns across EMEA. The agency emphasizes deep partnerships, fewer clients and high-impact results with B2B effectiveness at its core.

Ludwig+ is a woman-owned brand actualization and business acceleration agency with strong credentials in B2B marketing. It drives bold ideas and impactful results, exemplified by three wins of the ANA B2 Awards Small Agency of the Year (Bronze) and other accolades. The agency is recognized for work in purpose-led campaigns and category-shaping creativity.

Luxid is an independent global B2B marketing agency operating across the UK, US and Finland, specializing in growth-focused services that combine creativity, data and technology. Working with major brands like Dell Technologies, AWS, Cummins and Emerson, the agency has earned recognition in B2B Marketing’s Global Agencies Benchmarking Report.

Marco BBN Czech Republic is a specialist B2B marketing agency based in Brno and Prague and part of the global BBN network since 2001. It serves clients such as FedEx, Jotun, LeasePlan, Inoutic-Deceuninck and Brother with full-service B2B campaigns spanning strategy, digital acquisition and account-based marketing across CEE markets. The agency is lauded for bridging creativity, strategic insight and measurable results in industrial and enterprise segments.

Marketbridge is a data-driven B2B growth consultancy specializing in go-to-market strategy, analytics and demand acceleration. Known for its approach to customer intelligence and revenue optimization, it supports Fortune 500 brands across technology, finance and healthcare. Its work includes customer lifecycle modelling, segmentation and multi-channel marketing performance analytics. Marketbridge is recognized for delivering measurable revenue impact and for its expertise in data-rich, high-complexity marketing ecosystems.

Marketlogic is a B2B marketing and insights technology company helping enterprises build intelligence-powered marketing systems. Known for its market insights platforms used by global brands, it supports clients with research integration, strategic intelligence and content activation. Its solutions have been applied by companies in FMCG, finance and technology, enabling smarter decision-making and high-performance marketing. Marketlogic is recognized for innovation in insights management and enterprise knowledge systems.

McCann Enterprise is the corporate and B2B center of excellence within McCann Worldgroup, developing powerful ideas that help transform businesses and drive long-term growth. By combining brand strategy, customer experience, and deep expertise in routes-to-market, the agency helps organizations undergoing major change understand their culture and communicate who they truly are. Recent work includes a national tech-for-small-business campaign for EE, as well as initiatives for leading industrial and professional services brands. Backed by McCann Worldgroup’s award-winning network – recognized for industry-leading creative effectiveness across Europe and celebrated with honors such as the Grand Effie – McCann Enterprise brings the same strategic rigor and creativity to corporate and B2B transformation.

Merkle is a global B2B specialist agency within the Dentsu network, with over 900 B2B marketing professionals serving enterprise clients across technology, professional services and manufacturing. Known for its data- and tech-driven brand-to-demand model, Merkle delivers integrated capabilities in insights, media, creative, CRM and CX. Its award pedigree includes Large B2B Agency of the Year at The Drum B2B Awards and #1 International B2B Marcomms Agency 2023.

ModoModo Agency is a full-service B2B marketing partner based in Atlanta (US) working across technology, industrial/manufacturing, healthcare and transition/M&A sectors. The agency offers brand strategy, media, creative, lead gen, sales enablement and marketing management, supporting Fortune 500 and high-growth brands alike. It was listed on the Inc 5000 in 2025 (#1,409) and is known for delivering measurable business outcomes for complex buyer environments.

MOI Global is a global B2B agency built for technology brands, delivering brand, experience and demand services via its ‘Not-so-B2B Growth Engine.’ It serves clients like Adobe, Ciena, Oracle and Proofpoint and has a presence across London, New York, Seattle, Dubai, Singapore, Munich and Sydney.

Mower is a 100% employee-owned, women-led independent B2B marketing agency delivering full-funnel brand-to-demand solutions. With major clients including Carhartt Company Gear, FirstEnergy and National Grid, the agency excels in crafting campaigns that blend creative storytelling, digital transformation and pipeline impact. Highlights include being named Midsize Agency of the Year at the ANA B2 Awards and racking up 12 awards in 2025 alone, along with the 2024 North American Agency of the Year at the B2B Marketing Elevation Awards.

Nelson Schmidt is a fiercely independent full-service marketing communications agency based in Milwaukee that specializes in considered-purchase (B2B and complex B2C) and global marketing management. It emphasizes performance-based accountability and delivers measurable business outcomes for clients in the industrial, manufacturing and services sectors.

Ogilvy B2B is the business-to-business division of the global Ogilvy network, delivering full-funnel marketing from brand strategy and creative to demand-generation, ABM, digital and sales-enablement. With clients in the technology, professional services and industrial sectors, it leverages Ogilvy’s creative legacy, global scale and data-driven marketing infrastructure to translate complex B2B propositions into compelling narratives and measurable pipeline growth. The agency’s campaigns span digital, social, experiential and emerging platforms.

Park & Battery is a brand-marketing and content agency that blends strategic insight, creative boldness and go-to-market execution to serve ambitious B2B and enterprise clients. A multi-year winner of the Association of National Advertisers (ANA) Agency of the Year titles, its clients include Thermo Fisher Scientific, Meta, UBS Wealth Management and Esquire Bank and its standout campaigns like ‘Music Makes Us Better’ deliver brand-to-demand impact across digital, experiential and content-driven platforms.

Pretzl is a newly-formed global B2B marketing business combining five established agencies – Agent3 Group, Publitek, This Machine, Velocity and Twogether – under the umbrella of the Next 15 Group. It offers an AI-driven platform called JourneyLab to map buyer behaviour and deliver personalized experiences across the modern B2B funnel. The agency focuses on technology, manufacturing, professional and financial services, blending data, creative and demand generation to drive measurable business outcomes.

Publicis Pro is the B2B specialist arm of Publicis Groupe, acting as a center of excellence that combines brand-building, content, digital, media and demand generation under a unified ‘Brand to Sales’ model. It supports clients such as Smartsheet, Twilio and Rolls-Royce, using a global network of over 400 B2B specialists to scale campaigns internationally.

RA B2B is a strategic B2B marketing agency known for its integrated demand, brand and creative programs. With clients across technology, professional services and industrial sectors, the agency focuses on insight-driven planning and measurable growth. RA B2B has delivered award-winning work across digital transformation, brand positioning and ABM. Its collaborative model brings together strategy, creativity and performance to help clients convert complex propositions into clear business impact.
Radish is a B2B agency that specializes in integrated marketing for business buyers – combining brand, content, digital and demand generation to address complex buyer journeys.

Realm B2B is an independent global B2B marketing agency that specializes in delivering high-velocity campaigns for enterprise and complex-market clients. It emphasizes innovation, speed and collaboration, with a focus on leveraging deep B2B insight to deliver measurable impact across global markets. The agency works to keep things moving – combining creative strategy and demand-generation execution for clients worldwide.

Rooster Punk is a UK-based B2B storytelling agency that champions human-first creativity. Known for its emotive, narrative-driven approach, the agency works with brands including Samsung, Betfair and Telefonica. It has delivered award-winning brand transformations and campaigns focused on behavioural insight and emotional resonance. Rooster Punk is widely applauded for redefining B2B brand building and for pushing the industry toward more authentic, audience-centered marketing.

Schermer is a Minneapolis-based B2B marketing agency focused on turning relevance into revenue for business brands. They deliver data-driven insight, breakthrough creative and engaging experiences across sectors such as high tech, manufacturing, education and financial services, for clients including Best Buy, Red Wing Shoes, 3M and Honeywell. The agency has been recognized in the ANA B2 Awards.

Sköna is a B2B creative marketing agency operating out of San Francisco and Stockholm. With 20+ years of experience, it combines Scandinavian design sensibility with Silicon Valley energy, building bold, human-centered brands for B2B clients across branding, campaigns and digital.

Stein is a global B2B specialist agency recognized for bold creativity and full-funnel brand-to-demand strategy. Known for award-winning campaigns such as ‘By America’s Side’ for Mack Trucks and ‘People of Progress’ for Wolters Kluwer, it has earned ANA B2, Warc Effectiveness and Global Ace Awards. Serving clients like HSBC, Celonis and Juniper Networks, Stein blends insight, storytelling and measurable performance to elevate business growth worldwide.

Symphony Marketing is a Tokyo-based agency specializing exclusively in B2B marketing for enterprise clients. With more than 35 years of experience, it supports manufacturing, IT and service companies with marketing strategy, human resource development, demand center building and outsourcing services. It also partners globally (eg, with Just Global) to extend its reach beyond Japan.

The Croc is an independent B2B agency dedicated to delivering ‘Fierce Thinking’ for ambitious enterprise brands – building brand fame and driving demand through integrated strategy, creative, media, data & tech. Clients include AppDynamics, BetterHelp Business, ServiceNow and Lotlinx. The agency has picked up multiple Global Ace, B2B Marketing and The Drum awards for its full-funnel campaigns that unify big ideas with measurable business outcomes.

The MX Group is an independent US B2B marketing agency with more than 30 years of experience, specializing in brand-to-demand, demand generation, sales enablement and digital transformation. Clients span energy, utilities, manufacturing, SaaS and technology.

The Ricciardi Group is a New York-based agency built to partner with complex B2B brands and deliver insight-led, creative and full-funnel marketing services. Its philosophy is that ‘real growth demands bravery’ and it delivers brand-to-demand programs for clients in sectors like finance, technology and business services. It emphasizes bold work grounded in insight and a commercial mindset.

TMP B2B is a global marketing agency specializing in technology and professional services, assisting brands like Microsoft, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Salesforce with integrated brand, demand and partner strategies. Founded in the UK, the agency has been one of the most consistently awarded for lead generation and commercially successful work.

TMW Business is a UK-based specialist integrated B2B marketing agency (under the Unlimited B2B umbrella) offering strategy, creative, performance, ABM, sales-enablement and full-funnel execution. Its focus is on marrying insight-led communications with business outcomes, working with enterprise clients to turn technical propositions into compelling campaigns.

Torpedo is an award-winning full-service B2B marketing agency partnering with technology and industrial brands such as Adobe, Autodesk, and Panasonic Connect. Recently recognized at the 2024 B2B Marketing Awards for its ‘Making the UK Domain the Ultimate British Business Ally’ campaign for Nominet, the agency blends creative strategy, experience design, and technology to bring complex propositions to life. Torpedo has also created major campaigns including Autodesk Tandem’s go-to-market launch and Epson’s brand-growth initiative.

Traction is a modern marketing accelerator that works alongside in-house teams, blending consulting-level strategy with agency firepower. The agency supports clients such as Adobe, GE HealthCare and Lenovo, combining AI-enabled content engines, brand-to-demand models and high-speed execution. With its Futureproof Project community of marketing leaders and senior talent teams, Traction drives measurable growth and transformational marketing capability.

Transmission is an independent global B2B marketing agency built for enterprise and technology brands. Awarded Marketing Communications Agency of the Year, it combines data, creative, media and GTM strategy across markets. Known for work with Microsoft, AWS, HP and EY, it specializes in integrated demand generation and brand storytelling. Its acquisition of Earnest expanded its creative and strategic capabilities, strengthening its influence across EMEA, APAC and North America.

The B2B agency True’s central philosophy is to make memorable, high-impact advertising through a creative and strategic approach to B2B marketing, aiming to build brands and create lasting business value.

VCCP Business is the specialist B2B division of the global VCCP network, positioned as ‘the challenger B2B agency’ that brings world-class creative and sector-specialist teams to business-to-business clients. The agency is recognized for transforming complex B2B brands through bold ideas, high-impact narratives and measurable business outcomes – and recently climbed to #5 in the Global Agencies Benchmarking Report while placing #2 among the fastest growers.

WOB is a German B2B marketing agency with expertise in brand development, digital experience and international campaign execution. Known for its long-standing partnerships with global enterprise brands, WOB delivers creative strategy, content, digital services and CX programs. The agency has received multiple European marketing awards for its work in technology, manufacturing and B2B services. WOB is respected for combining creativity with rigorous strategic and operational delivery.
